Owner selects COL 3KV7Z / Sporely 14834 for dunpipe; PLPT2 / 165605 is not selected. Owner considers the latter a possible stale/duplicate concept, not evidence of a biological ambiguity. Species Fungorum record 331935 confirms the selected current name/authorship and Cyphellaceae placement. Pinned metadata on PLPT2 instead places it in Ascomycota/Dothideomycetes/Dothideales/Parodiopsidaceae, inconsistent with the selected Basidiomycota/Agaricomycetes fungus. No identity deletion or supersession is inferred.
